description.p: Git Ronin is a free Git client. It runs your own git, so hooks, credential helpers, SSH configuration and commit signing work exactly as they do on the command line.

ul.li: A commit graph for all branches, remotes and tags that opens large repositories instantly
Stage whole files, single hunks or single lines, and commit with sign-off or amend
Drag a branch onto another to merge, rebase, reset or push it, and undo it afterwards
A merge conflict editor, interactive rebase, blame, file history and bisect
Submodules, working trees, Git LFS and Git Flow
Pull requests, issues and CI checks from GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket and Azure DevOps
Profiles, workspaces, a terminal panel, and settings synced through your own repository
